proposal.body:
Hi everyone, I'm Ting-An Chen (`nrps9909`). I'd like to follow the Ant Design Collaborator path and take on ongoing maintenance of **Menu/Dropdown keyboard activation and focus behavior**, including the canonical `@rc-component/menu` / `dropdown` fixes and their Ant Design integration.

My current role is an external contributor with READ permission and no organization membership or write access. My earlier work includes [Upload focus-event forwarding #59002](https://github.com/ant-design/ant-design/pull/59002), [localized Modal/Notification close-button names #58957](https://github.com/ant-design/ant-design/pull/58957), and [Input.Password repeated-key activation #59135](https://github.com/ant-design/ant-design/pull/59135), all merged. The current public record has 25 merged Ant Design main-repository PRs; [dated evidence and counting rules](https://github.com/nrps9909/nrps9909/blob/main/evidence/oss-2026-10-07.json) distinguish those from reviews and open work.

For this scope, I can keep providing minimal issue reproductions, check overlapping work before proposing fixes, review the actual PR commit with regression and native-browser evidence, and follow fixes through the dependency release and Ant Design integration. I would work with existing authors and take ownership of unclaimed follow-ups agreed with maintainers.

I started today with [rc-menu #898 review](https://github.com/react-component/menu/pull/898#pullrequestreview-5439489565), which addresses the long-standing [#57766](https://github.com/ant-design/ant-design/issues/57766). The original link-navigation behavior works on the tested head, but real Chrome tests found duplicate Enter activation (including a multiple-selection regression) and lost `preventScroll`. Complete head/merge-preview tests pass 146/146, so the browser cases add coverage beyond the existing suite. The review includes base comparisons, exact commits, and actionable reproduction steps.

I understand the current Collaborators guide also expects a significant contribution in addition to sustained maintenance. Would this focused maintenance scope be useful, and is there an unclaimed long-standing keyboard/focus feature you would recommend I own to meet that requirement? I can use the existing issues/PRs to report progress and follow your preferred review process.

Thanks for your time.

Ting-An Chen / `nrps9909`

AI assistance disclosure: Codex helped research the published process, run the isolated tests and browser probes, and prepare this proposal. The linked commits, test outcomes, and current permission boundary were verified.
